blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings including Portfolio Tasting, Flights & Bites Tasting, and Heritage Tour & Tasting. The winery features award-winning wines made from estate and regional vineyards. The site includes a bistro, gardens, and architecturally significant buildings.
extraNote: Tastings are non-refundable · Credit cards required to secure all bookings · Cancellation fee of $20 for cancellations with less than 4 hours’ notice · $25 fee for no-shows · Wine club membership requires commitment for one year with $50 cancellation fee if cancelled early · Wine shipments require signature of sober adult 19+
